mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_settings (system_id, column_no, display_name, is_visible, is_required, data_type, display_width, is_url, display_order, code_id, default_value, search_type) VALUES (#{systemId}, #{columnNo}, #{displayName}, #{isVisible}, #{isRequired}, #{dataType}, #{displayWidth}, #{isUrl}, #{displayOrder}, #{codeId}, #{defaultValue}, #{searchType})
mapper.update: UPDATE item_settings SET display_name = #{displayName}, is_visible = #{isVisible}, is_required = #{isRequired}, data_type = #{dataType}, display_width = #{displayWidth}, is_url = #{isUrl}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, code_id = #{codeId}, default_value = #{defaultValue}, search_type = #{searchType} WHERE system_id = #{systemId} AND column_no = #{columnNo}
